text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a small, fast deploy at 22:00 UTC tonight: runtime v2.4.1 (kernel-batching fix) + router header switch. Need console to hold at pinned ui-schema v1.8 and API to allow both header versions for ~10m. Anyone object?

Sam: ok from API side. Can we feature-flag the header flip? fallback header name = X-Redwood-Alt. @Leo can console expose a toggle? :thumbsup:

Cheng: Runtime team - v2.4.1 reduces tail latency but changes KV eviction heuristics. Recommend canary 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 10m before full roll. Also watch for cold-start spikes on small models.

DeployBot: canary started — runtime v2.4.1 deployed to shard s-09, target traffic 5%. Monitoring hooks: errors > 0.5% OR p95 +30% -> auto-roll. (trigger window: 5m)

Leo: Console will pin ui-schema v1.8.1 for this window. I can add a temporary migration toggle for header parity (legacy vs new). I'll push the toggle behind env var `CONSOLE_HEADER_MIGRATE`.

Anita: Ops-oncall here. Set alert if p95 latency increases > 30% or error rate > 0.4% sustained for 3m. If alerts fire, escalate to SRE and prepare rollback. Also confirm logs include request header snapshot for debugging.

Sam: Pushing API compat change now. Config snippet:
```
api.headers.accept: ["X-Redwood", "X-Redwood-Alt"]
canary.window_sec: 900
```
I'll also enable a short-lived compatibility middleware to translate new -> old header for downstream.

Maya: Rollback playbook (short):
- If errors or latency breach -> `deploybot rollback runtime v2.4.0 --immediate`
- Console pin stays until manual unpin (to avoid UI drift)
- API toggle rollback: flip compat middleware off, revert header acceptance
- Postmortem if > 30m outage.

DeployBot: canary metrics @ +1m: errors=0.18%, p95 latency +12% vs baseline, CPU stable. Continuing.

Cheng: Good to continue. I'll keep a closer eye on KV eviction counts and KV hit ratio. If eviction rate jumps > 40% we cut the canary.

Leo: Toggle is live behind `CONSOLE_HEADER_MIGRATE=true` in staging -> promoting to prod toggle. Will post the PR link in 2m.

Anita: I'm in the health dashboard. Setting temporary dashboard 1) p95, 2) error-rate, 3) kv-evictions. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

Maya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in this thread at 22:10 UTC for status and a decision to ramp or rollback. If anything urgent, ping @Anita and @Cheng.

Sam: ack. Posting deploy command for trace: `deploybot deploy runtime v2.4.1 --canary 5 --shard s-09`

DeployBot: Note: automatic roll condition configured: errors > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > baseline * 1.3 for 5m.

Cheng: Canary at +7m still green. No KV anomaly yet.

Anita: Monitoring shows p95 trending but within threshold. No alerts. Keeping watch.

Maya: copy — keeping channel open. If we hit any threshold, we execute rollback playbook above.
